method: Campaign data: Merkl v4 /campaigns?opportunityId= (creatorAddress, amount, start/end); raw raw/eth/gap-2026-10-07/top5-risk/merkl_campaigns.json

Reward APR at T = campaign amount/duration annualized / destination vault totalAssets at T (archive read); applies pro rata to every unblacklisted holder (whitelist and blacklist empty for active campaigns).
Product $/yr = APR x the product's destination claim at T. Token sources traced with Blockscout ERC-20 transfer history (raw http/bs_*.json).
